description: Prices for one outright tournament from the named bookmakers. Golf markets: Winner, Top 5, Top 10, Top 20 (boundary ties under dead-heat rules), Top 5 (Incl. Ties), Top 10 (Incl. Ties), Top 20 (Incl. Ties) (ties paid in full) and Make Cut (only events with a cut). Runners carry label, participantId and odds (+ layOdds on exchanges), or yes/no for Make Cut, sorted shortest price first. A full field is large: pass markets and maxRunners. Needs the Outrights add-on: a 403 means the key does not have it, so tell the user the message and do not retry.

bookmakers.description: Comma-separated bookmaker names, max 30 (e.g. 'Bet365,SingBet'). Must be in the key's selection (get_selected_bookmakers).

markets.description: Optional comma-separated market names to keep, e.g. 'Winner,Top 10 (Incl. Ties)' (filtered after the call)

maxRunners.description: Optional: keep only the first N runners (shortest prices) per market

name: get_outright_odds
title: Outright odds
